project_type: Next.js 16.2.10 App Router with React 19, CFA Level I preparation app
build_system: npm with Next.js build. No brazil. Uses vitest for tests.
test_framework: vitest with globals:true, environment:node, includes src/**/*.{test,property.test}.{ts,tsx}
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors), 2. npm run lint (pass), 3. npm run build (success), 4. npm run test (all pass)
setup_instructions: npm install && npx prisma generate (already done in sandbox)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Full npm/docker access. Recharts must be lazy-loaded with dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false }). NEVER use useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads - use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer. NEVER call router.push() during render phase.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/). CSS variables for theming. Dark mode compatible. Mobile responsive. Run tsc + lint + build before done.

key_patterns.page_structure: src/app/(protected)/{route}/page.tsx imports a content component from src/features/{name}/components/
key_patterns.data_access: localStorage reads use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer or module-level cached useSyncExternalStore (dashboard hook). Session data from getSessions() in session-storage.ts. Questions from loadAllQuestions() in question-loader.ts.
key_patterns.chart_lazy_loading: Use dynamic(() => import('recharts').then(m => m.ComponentName), { ssr: false }) - see insights-content.tsx for pattern
key_patterns.theming: CSS variables: var(--background), var(--card-bg), var(--card-border), var(--foreground), var(--foreground-secondary), var(--accent-primary=#002B5C), var(--accent-secondary=#C5A258), var(--accent-success=#00843D), var(--border)
key_patterns.navigation: Add to src/shared/config/navigation.ts navigationItems array with lucide-react icon
key_patterns.component_style: Client components with 'use client' directive, inline styles using CSS variables for theme compatibility, tailwind for layout

directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ = routes with sidebar layout. src/features/ = feature modules with components/, utils/, types/. src/shared/ = cross-feature (config/, components/layout/, hooks/, lib/). All session data in localStorage key 'cfa-buddy-sessions'. Questions in 'cfa-buddy-imported-questions'.
